newsitem.title: USA: Paramount Calif. hydrotreater shuts Fri. - traders.
newsitem.headline: Paramount Calif. hydrotreater shuts Fri. - traders.

text.p: West Coast petroleum and products traders Monday said diesel prices would likely firm following a weekend fire at a hydrotreater at Paramount's 30,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) Los Angeles refinery.
Company and fire department officials were not available to confirm how long the unit would remain shut.
"The market's firmed up," a broker said, adding the refinery had not begun to buy supplies.
"What little diesel they had, they won't have now," the broker said. "They were a seller."
Hydrotreaters remove sulphur from diesel fuel.
CARB diesel prices on Friday ranged 86.50 to 88.00 cents a gallon in Los Angeles. They were seen at those levels early Monday, while traders assessed the effects of the fire.
